text:
Ari (Designer): Hey team — quick copy review for the model upload error state. User report: failing to upload a large model artifact shows a generic red banner: "Upload failed. Try again." and a single "Retry" button. Screenshot & repro: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/model-upload-error.png

Problem: support says users are confused whether retry will resume an interrupted upload or restart from scratch. Also we don't indicate quota vs network errors. Need copy variants and accessibility notes.

Devon (ENG): Thanks. Technical details: we use multipart uploads with resume token when supported, otherwise restart. Backend returns an error.type field: network|quota|file_too_large|checksum. Currently frontend just maps any non-200 to generic error. We can plumb error.type to UI.

Priya (CS): From support tickets: common cases are network flakiness and file too large. Users often retry repeatedly and then hit quota. Suggest we differentiate and suggest actions. For quota say "reduce file size or contact support". For network say "Resume upload" if resumable.

Samira (A11y): Microcopy must be explicit and include clear targets for screen readers. Avoid vague verbs. Examples: "Upload interrupted. Resume upload (recommended)" vs "Upload failed due to file size. Reduce file size and try again." Also ensure alert has role="alert" and include an aria-describedby id that points to the suggested action link text.

Ari (Designer): Proposed variants:
- Variant A (resumable/network): "Upload interrupted. You can resume the upload. [Resume upload] [Cancel]
Hint: File upload will pick up where it left off if your connection is stable."
- Variant B (file too large): "Upload failed — file is too large. Reduce file size or split the model into smaller files. [Learn how] [Cancel]"
- Variant C (quota): "Upload blocked — storage quota reached. Contact your admin or upgrade your plan. [Contact support] [Manage billing]"

Devon (ENG): Implementation notes: we can render different banners based on error.type and whether the upload session has a resume_token. For resume flow the primary CTA should be Resume (actionable) and secondary Cancel. For errors like quota, primary could be Contact support or Manage billing. I caution about too many links in a small banner.

Priya (CS): For contact/support CTAs please point to a prefilled support form with context (team id, workspace, error code) to reduce back-and-forth. Also for Learn how link we should direct to a KB article: /docs/model-upload#splitting-models.

Samira (A11y): A few accessibility nits: 1) Make CTA buttons focusable and in DOM order primary-first. 2) Use visually-hidden text for extra context like error code: "Error code: ERR_UPLOAD_42" so screen readers can read it but not visual clutter. 3) For the resume action, ensure the button has aria-disabled during the resume handshake, and announce status changes via aria-live polite region.

Ari (Designer): Tone: keep calm, avoid alarm language. Replace "failed" with context-rich phrasing. Example small copy for network: "Upload interrupted. Resume where you left off." For file too large: "This file exceeds the 2GB limit." (we'll fill exact limit dynamically).

Devon (ENG): We'll add server-side error.detail when available with limit numbers. Also returns resume_token boolean. I'll change the mapping and open PR.

Priya (CS): Can we show an inline mini-retry dropdown for network with options: Resume / Restart / Pause? Might be overkill. For now Resume + Cancel is fine.

Ari (Designer): Final microcopy candidates to include in the PR description:
- Network (resumable): "Upload interrupted. Resume upload to continue from where it stopped." CTA primary: "Resume upload" CTA secondary: "Cancel"
- Network (non-resumable): "Upload interrupted. Retry to start again." CTA primary: "Retry upload" CTA secondary: "Cancel"
- File too large: "This file is too large ({{size}}). Reduce the file size or split the model." CTA primary: "Learn how" CTA secondary: "Cancel"
- Quota: "Storage quota reached for your org. Contact your admin or manage billing." CTA primary: "Contact support" CTA secondary: "Manage billing"

Samira (A11y): LGTM. Add screen-reader-only text with the error code and suggested next step. Also make the whole banner keyboard-navigable and ensure escape dismisses non-critical banners but not critical quota blocks (confirm before dismiss).

Devon (ENG): I'll implement the UI branches, aria attributes, and the prefilled support link. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4689 — includes new banner component, tests, and copy variants. Tagging @Ari for design review.

build-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/upload-errors/v1 (expires in 48h) :package:

Ari (Designer): Thanks all — I'll add copy snippets to the component story and include the sr-only examples. Priya can you review KB links?

Priya (CS): Sure, will check docs and prefill form params. Minor suggestion: For "Manage billing" route, route to org-billing page, not account billing.

Samira (A11y): I'll give a quick pass on the PR for aria-live behavior and focus handling after Devon pushes.

Devon (ENG): Pushed a small fix after Samira's notes. PR updated.

Ari (Designer): Merging once PR approved. Leaving a note to avoid using exclamation marks in the banners. :slightly_smiling_face:
